in_sanskrit.name: केशर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has abundant hair or a tuft of hair on the forehead.

in_marathi.name: Keshar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Keshar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Keshar is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kesha’ which means ‘hair’. In Hindu mythology, Keshar is a name given to gods and heroes with golden hair.
